# THV-guard

> THV-guard is a research-preview AI business-action verification concept by Tuan Hung Vu Technologies Pte. Ltd. Tool access is not transaction approval.

## Current status
- Research preview; seeking technical design partners.
- No production enforcement engine, production integrations, compliance certification, or cryptographic guarantees are claimed.
- Refund policy simulation is local and deterministic. It does not execute payments or intercept live agent actions.
- SGD pilot pricing is indicative only, not a live offer or subscription.

## Pages
- [About us](/en/about): Business story beginning in 2023, Singapore origins in an AI-security hackathon, and the motivation for guarding business logic. The story start is not a claim about the company’s legal incorporation date.
- [Product](/en/product): Intended capabilities and product principles.
- [Simulator](/en/simulator): Fictional USD 250 order, USD 50 already refunded, USD 200 remaining, approval threshold USD 100.
- [Architecture](/en/architecture): Proposed action boundary, responsibilities, and failure modes.
- [Pricing](/en/pricing): Research demo and indicative pilot discussion tiers.
- [Contact](/en/contact): Prepare an email for contact@tuanhungvu.com; the visitor must send it themselves.
- [Privacy](/en/privacy): Local demo data, email handling, and analytics disclosure.
